summary: Tested new AI-powered calorie+protein calculator endpoint POST /api/weight-metabolism/{pid}/ai-calculate-goals. 5/5 tests passed covering male/female scenarios, missing-data 400 German error, weight_log fallback, response shape, bounds, multiples-of-50/5, ±15% TDEE sanity clamp, and no _id leak.
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint is well-structured: resolves weight priority (req → weight_log → profile) correctly.
Deterministic Mifflin-St Jeor anchor + ±10% LLM guidance + safety clamps (1200-5000 kcal, 40-300g protein, multiples of 50/5) are robust.
LLM fallback path produces a deterministic German note mentioning Mifflin-St Jeor, and the baseline is still returned — good resilience.
Minor: AIGoalRequest.current_weight_kg/height_cm/age lack numeric range validation (Pydantic Field constraints). Invalid (e.g., negative) values would silently propagate to TDEE calc. Not blocking.
Minor: height stored as float in request, but response echoes as int when age is int(profile.get('age') or 0) — types acceptable.
No _id leak anywhere — confirmed via response text scan.
seed_data_creation: Created weight_log entry (72.5kg) for test_uses_latest_weight_log under throwaway TEST_ profile_id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI goal calc endpoint is fully green. Male 85kg active build → ~3000kcal/130g; female 65kg moderate lose → lower than male (verified). Tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_weight_metabolism_ai_goals.py. Uses real gpt-4o-mini (~5 LLM calls per full run).
